key_concepts: Scientific method is a step-by-step procedure for solving problems
It helps researchers organize ideas and construct procedures
It produces reliable and valid results based on experiments and data
The first step is identifying the problem
A hypothesis is an educated guess about the solution
Experimentation is an organized process to test a hypothesis
Gathering data involves making judgments based on experimental results
A conclusion is the final decision or judgment
Scientific method is used by scientists to seek factual and concrete findings
Results of scientific investigations can support or oppose a theory
Scientific method can be applied in everyday life activities
